title_zh: 描述一个你参加过的地方节日或庆祝活动

cue_card.prompt: Describe a local festival or celebration you have taken part in.
bullets: when and where this festival took place
what people did during the festival
how you felt about taking part in it

part3.question: Why do you think people in many countries enjoy holding festivals together?
Do you think traditional festivals are becoming more similar around the world, or are they still quite different?
Should governments spend public money on festivals and celebrations, or is this a waste of money?

fallback_questions: What kinds of festivals are popular in your country?
Do young people and old people enjoy the same kinds of celebrations?
How have the ways people celebrate changed in recent years?
